en-US.author: Buildkite Pty. Ltd.
en-US.description: The Buildkite Agent is an open-source toolkit written in Go for securely running build jobs on any device or network
en-US.longDescription: The buildkite-agent is a small, reliable, and cross-platform build runner that makes it easy to run automated builds on your own infrastructure. It's main responsibilities are polling buildkite.com for work, running build jobs, reporting back the status code and output log of the job, and uploading the job's artifacts.
en-US.name: Buildkite Agent
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
This release supports longer-lived job-dispatch streams and application-level keepalives, reducing unnecessary reconnections.

🔒 Security
- Prevent plugin cache collisions from running the wrong hooks by @ss1909 in #4610

🐛 Fixed
- Fix shutdown hangs after failed job acceptance by @tomanagle in #4556
- Reject --append fetches with BUILDKITE_COMMIT=HEAD by @ss1909 in #4608
- Respect BUILDKITE_SKIP_CHECKOUT during pipeline upload by @CerealBoy in #4609

🔧 Changed
- Let Buildkite control ping-stream lifetimes by @moskyb in #4614 + #4611
- Spread registration retries with exponential backoff and jitter by @ss1909 in #4597
- De-emphasise cache housekeeping logs by @wolfeidau in #4606

🏠 Internal
- Dependency updates by @dependabot[bot] in #4585, #4598, #4599 and #4600

New Contributors
- @tomanagle made their first contribution in #4556
